goals: Calibrate estimate-plan guard budgets from curated non-authoritative CLI cost telemetry. Add src/planner/estimate-telemetry.ts with a versioned sample catalog (documented cli-estimated USD amounts plus evidencePath provenance, labeled S/M/L/XL), percentile helper (P75), and calibrateGuardUsd(size) that returns ceil_to_cent(P75 * 1.25) when sampleSize >= 3 for that size, otherwise the existing static floor with confidence low. Update src/planner/estimate.ts so estimateTask/estimatePlan use the calibrated guard, keep heuristic size/turns/wall/token and public-price CNY ranges, and expose calibration metadata (basis, sampleSize, confidence, p75Usd, margin, usedStaticFloor) on each task plus a plan-level calibration summary/notes. Never mark samples authoritative; never invent provider balance/quota/invoice. Extend tests/estimate.test.ts to prove P75+margin calibration for a well-sampled size, static-floor fallback for an under-sampled size, and that pricingReference stays non-binding.
nonGoals: Do not add Plan complexity-signal schema.
Do not ingest live .cliyard/runs in this slice.
Do not claim provider-reported price, balance or quota.
Do not wire estimates into automatic admission or budget approval.
deliverables: Curated CLI cost telemetry catalog with evidence provenance.
P75+margin guard calibration with cold-start static floor.
Estimate output exposes calibration metadata without claiming authority.
forbidden: Do not mark cli-estimated samples as authoritative.
Do not invent provider balance, quota or invoice totals.
Do not change CostTruth or acceptance authority.
